🔥Welcome to Weapon Duels, where players compete in 1v1 to 4v4 duels using knives, guns, and abilities!

1. Step on a duels pad to play!
2. Earn coins to purchase cosmetics & abilities!
3. Compete to reach the top of the leaderboards!
4. Collect weapon skins, effects, finishers, titles, abilities, and reach level 50!

Join our server for codes!
Ask one of the owners for a secret code😱

⚠️Cheating, exploiting, alt farming, and abusing glitches will result in a permanent ban!

Inspired by Murder Mystery 2 (MM2), Murderers vs Sheriff Duels (MVSD), and Rivals. Credits to those games.
